title: validateApp: require non-empty owner; pass package.json team from core-shell, billing, reports

summary: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty/non-string. core-shell (platform), billing (payments), reports (insights) pass the team from their package.json (hardcoded literals matching package.json, since apps are browser bundles). All in the mono repo; the shared lib is inlined, so no version bump or other repo needed. Assumption: whitespace-only owner counts as empty. PR #1 merged, CI+CD green.
